title: The Empty Feast
text: A long table laid for a feast, food still warm, chairs pushed back as if everyone stood up at once and fled. A goblet lies spilled. A placecard at the head of the table names your poorest House, in fine gold ink.

options.label: The poorest House takes the head of the table, as the placecard insists.

outcomes.text: The food is real and very good. No one comes back for it.
The guests return, hungry. They are not angry that you sat; they are pleased.

options.label: Pocket the silver and go, before the guests return.

outcomes.text: The silver is very fine and very cold. It never warms, no matter how long it is held.

options.label: Leave it all untouched. Whatever made them flee may still be here.

outcomes.text: Behind you the candles go out one by one. The smell of the food follows you for a day, making your own bread taste of ash.
